title: Returns
policy_text: Unused products may be returned within 7 calendar days of delivery. Items must retain original tags and packaging. Products marked final sale are not returnable.

title: Discounted item returns
policy_text: Discounted products can be returned within 7 calendar days of delivery if unused and in original packaging with tags attached. After 7 days they are not eligible for return.

title: Refunds
policy_text: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item passes inspection.

title: Shipping
policy_text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders over ₹2,500 qualify for free standard shipping; other orders have a ₹99 standard shipping fee.

title: Exchanges
policy_text: Size exchanges may be requested within 7 calendar days of delivery for unused items with tags attached. Exchanges are subject to stock availability.

title: Warranty
policy_text: Manufacturing defects are covered for 90 days from delivery. Normal wear, accidental damage, and improper care are not covered.
